reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for managing persistent model prompts, inspecting their session-scoped assembly, and viewing related context and tool-schema size estimates through a browser panel.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中通过独立面板管理持久提示词，并检查其按会话代理作用域进行的系统提示词装配结果。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that provides a browser panel for managing persistent prompts and inspecting their session-scoped system-prompt assembly.

capabilities: Creates, edits, reorders, enables, and disables persistent prompts
Injects managed prompts into the host system prompt registry for subsequent model assembly
Persists prompt data in a local JSON file under DSH_HOME
Provides a browser panel and local GET/POST routes for prompt management
Simulates prompt assembly and displays prompt, context, variable, and tool-schema size estimates
